propositions: rebar-gerrit-voter-errors alarm declares no alarm_actions or ok_actions, causing OK→ALARM transitions to notify nobody despite being the LLM-Review safety net that gates main submissions
rebar-gerrit-replication-errors has the identical silent-alarm defect; both are the only two of thirteen CloudWatch alarms in the repo lacking actions

CloudWatch alarm resource blocks throughout infra/terraform/ follow an established convention of wiring both alarm_actions and ok_actions to aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn, but voter_errors and replication_errors were omitted from this pattern

a terraform guard test must parse all aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm blocks and fail if any lack alarm_actions, carrying an anti-vacuity assertion to prevent vacuous passing and requiring an explicit documented opt-out marker for intentionally silent alarms
merging HCL does not apply terraform; the alarms must be deployed via operator-run terraform apply before they notify anyone in production
